scan_summary: 5-angle arXiv/GitHub scan. 10 papers/repos found. 3 staged (2 medium-risk new scripts, 1 low-risk wiki update). Key new findings: speaker-weighted FinBERT (2604.13260) as H247 candidate; BABB factor (2409.00416) as H248 candidate; factor timing regime framework (2410.14841) for wiki and H249 design.

papers.title: Pairs Trading Using a Novel Graphical Matching Approach
papers.note: Already known as H200 in pipeline (pairs-trading.md). Sharpe 1.23 on S&P 500 2017-2023. Not staged — already planned.

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Pair Trading: A Dynamic Scaling Approach
papers.note: Crypto-focused RL pairs. Not immediately actionable for equity pipeline.

papers.title: Extracting the Structure of Press Releases for Predicting Earnings Announcement Returns
papers.note: Already incorporated in H244 design (staged 2026-06-02). Not re-staged.

papers.title: Which Voices Move Markets? Speaker Identity and Cross-Section of Post-Earnings Returns
papers.note: NEW — speaker-weighted FinBERT (CFO 30%/Analyst 49%/Executive 16%/Other 5%). Monthly L/S alpha 2.03%, t=6.49, FF5-unexplained. Direct H174 upgrade path. Staged as H247.

papers.title: Predicting Stock Price Direction on Earnings Announcement Days using Multi-Modal Deep Learning
papers.note: Already incorporated in H244 design. Multimodal fusion reference. Not re-staged.

papers.title: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
papers.note: Unifies TS and CS momentum but doesn't solve short-leg reversal problem. Background only.

papers.title: Winners vs. Losers: Momentum-based Strategies with Intertemporal Choice for ESG Portfolios
papers.note: Tail-risk (Rachev ratio) for short-leg weighting. ESG-focused; secondary priority for H243 v2.

papers.title: Betting Against (Bad) Beta
papers.note: NEW — BABB double-sort on total beta + bad beta. +800bps Sharpe vs BAB. H192-D BAB confirmed at 1.367. BABB is systematic upgrade + potential uncorrelated H228 complement. Staged as H248.

papers.title: Dynamic Factor Allocation Leveraging Regime-Switching Signals
papers.note: NEW — SJM+BL factor timing, 8x IR improvement over equal-weight. Directly explains H245 failure (rate-hike killed low-vol). Wiki update staged for factor-models.md. H249 design candidate.

papers.title: FinBERT2 / ProsusAI/finBERT ecosystem
papers.note: Already noted in nlp-alternative-data.md (2026-05-22). H174 upgrade path if classification accuracy < 55%. Not re-staged.
